gaps: No CLI or SDK offers offline search over chat history
No tool tracks credit spend or token usage across chats
No tool captures SSE streams for scripting
v1-era chats are not served by the v2 API (422 API v2 does not support this chat)
patterns: Bearer token auth via V0_API_KEY (Authorization: Bearer)
Blocking create/send endpoints plus /async (poll messageId) and /stream (SSE) variants
Usage object with tokens + creditsCost on every generation response
recommendation: Generate a v2-native CLI with sync-to-SQLite, offline search, spend analytics, and streaming capture

novel_features.name: Credit spend analytics
novel_features.description: Aggregate v0 credit cost and token usage from the synced message mirror, grouped by chat, day, or model.
novel_features.rationale: Every v0 generation bills credits (usage.creditsCost); no existing tool tracks burn across chats.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this when an agent needs to know where v0 credits went, which chats are expensive, or a daily burn rate.

novel_features.name: Streaming capture
novel_features.description: Create a chat and stream the SSE response live, rendering each event and recording model attribution for spend analytics.
novel_features.rationale: Blocking create returns only after the model finishes; streaming shows thinking, file edits, and usage as they happen.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this when an agent needs to see generation progress live or capture the event stream for later analysis.

novel_features.name: Tail chat generation
novel_features.description: Poll a chat until the newest assistant message finishes, with --follow for continuous watching.
novel_features.rationale: Async endpoints return a messageId; tailing removes the need to hand-poll for completion.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this when an agent kicked off an async generation and needs to wait for it deterministically.

novel_features.name: Chat file tree
novel_features.description: Render a chat's generated source files as an indented directory tree.
novel_features.rationale: Downloading and unzipping files to see structure is slow; a tree is instant and diff-able.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this when an agent needs to understand a generated app's layout before editing.

novel_features.name: Preview URL helper
novel_features.description: Print only the live preview URL for a chat, ready for embedding or scripting.
novel_features.rationale: The preview response carries url + short-lived token; --url strips everything else.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this when an agent needs the preview URL for CI, screenshots, or quick checks.

novel_features.name: Offline search
novel_features.description: Full-text search over synced chats and messages without hitting the API.
novel_features.rationale: The v2 API has no search endpoint; FTS over the local mirror makes history greppable.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this when an agent needs to find a past chat or message without paging the API.

novel_features.name: Local sync mirror
novel_features.description: Cursor-paginated sync of chats and messages into a local SQLite mirror for offline search and spend analytics.
novel_features.rationale: Powers every offline capability; the API has no bulk export.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Run once before offline search or spend commands.

novel_features.name: Auth diagnostics
novel_features.description: Validate V0_API_KEY and API reachability with a live check.
novel_features.rationale: Fail-fast diagnostics before scripting against the API.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this when a script 401s and you need to know why.

narrative.headline: Generate and iterate on web apps with v0 from the terminal: create chats from prompts, stream agent output, sync history to a local SQLite mirror, and track credit spend across models.
narrative.value_prop: The v0 API v2 CLI with offline search, streaming capture, and credit-spend analytics — no other tool tracks where your v0 credits go.
narrative.auth_narrative: Requires a v0 API key (create one at https://v0.app/settings/keys). Set V0_API_KEY in your environment, or use auth set-token. The CLI sends Authorization: Bearer <key>.

quickstart.comment: Verify the CLI and API key are configured correctly

quickstart.command: v0-pp-cli chats stream "Create a landing page" --model v0-mini
quickstart.comment: Create a chat and stream the generation live
Sync chats and messages into the local mirror
See where your v0 credits went this week

troubleshoots.fix: V0_API_KEY is missing, invalid, or expired; create a key at https://v0.app/settings/keys

troubleshoots.symptom: 422 "API v2 does not support this chat"
troubleshoots.fix: The chat was created through the v1 API; v2 only serves v2-created chats
Run doctor to verify auth and connectivity before debugging

narrative.when_to_use: Use v0-pp-cli to generate and iterate on web apps via the v0 API: creating chats from prompts, sending follow-up messages, fetching generated files and previews, deploying to Vercel, managing MCP servers and webhooks, and tracking credit spend.
anti_triggers: Do not use this CLI for editing files inside a generated app's sandbox directly; fetch files and edit locally instead.
Do not use this CLI to manage Vercel infrastructure outside v0 chats; that is Vercel's own API surface.
Do not use this CLI as a general-purpose coding agent; it generates apps through v0, not in the current directory.

recipes.title: Create a chat and wait for it
recipes.command: v0-pp-cli chats create --message "A minimal landing page" --title Landing --privacy private --json
recipes.explanation: Blocking create returns the chat plus token/credit usage once the model finishes.

recipes.title: Stream a generation and record the model
recipes.command: v0-pp-cli chats stream "A pricing page" --model v0-pro --privacy private
recipes.explanation: Streams SSE events live and records model attribution so spend --by model works.

recipes.title: Send a follow-up asynchronously and tail it
recipes.command: v0-pp-cli messages send-async ft7dqhYEX8n --message "Add dark mode" --json
recipes.explanation: Async send returns a messageId; poll it with messages tail until finishReason is set.

recipes.title: Inspect generated files as a tree
recipes.explanation: Renders the generated app's file layout without downloading the archive.

recipes.title: Track weekly credit spend by chat
recipes.explanation: After sync, aggregates usage.creditsCost and tokens from the local mirror.

recipes.title: Embed a live preview
recipes.explanation: Prints just the preview URL for embedding or scripting.

trigger_phrases: generate a web app with v0
send a message to a v0 chat
